gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws round letters with a clear channel leading in and no stroke shift. Noto Sans Cherokee follows in a tall, approachable plain sans.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-chorasmia: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads large and contemporary, its curves stopping short instead of closing, with ascenders kept low. Autour One's heavy horizontals sit above it, bold and uniform.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Autour One draws every stroke as if with a fixed pen, so its round letters look uniform and bold. Noto Sans Coptic is a clean sans-serif whose middle zone dominates each line, and its s and c stay open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Laser-cut and loud. Autour One keeps one stroke width throughout, while Noto Sans Cuneiform swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads and leaves each e open instead of closing its eye.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Neutral and modern, up close. Autour One's plain outline carries the bold display voice, while Noto Sans Devanagari tucks capitals into a compact sans-serif skyline with an open-curved g.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Round, bold, brush-free. Autour One is at its best when large, with no pointed-brush swell in its curves, and Noto Sans Duployan is best at text size, its sans-serif a and e wide open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Autour One brings expressive, bold display letters where curves are as thick as the straight stems. But Noto Sans Elbasan is the one built for text, a plain sans with large lowercase and terminals that never pinch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Expressive, and unshaded. Autour One shows off its bold round forms with no pressure swells, while Noto Sans Elymaic does the quieter work in sans-serif text with open apertures and short ascenders.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic stands tall, sturdy and modern. Autour One looks like glass tubing bent into letters, and above that sturdy sans-serif it supplies the bold, expressive display voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian reads modern and clean, its curves open and its ascender stems short on tall lowercase. Autour One does the loud work, bold display letters with no thick-and-thin modulation at all.
